title: Pahang Marathon 2026 Review: Kuantan's East-Coast Full Marathon
seo_title: Pahang Marathon 2026 Review | Kuantan Malaysia Race
meta_description: The Pahang Marathon 2026: September 6 at Dataran Sayangi Kuantan. Full and half marathon with registration open — Malaysia's east-coast state marathon.
dek: Set for 6 September 2026 at Dataran Sayangi Kuantan in Pahang, this community-organised marathon offers full and half distances with registration open. An east-coast Malaysian road race with genuine grassroots support.
verdict: The Pahang Marathon brings a full 42.195km to Kuantan — Pahang's state capital on Malaysia's east coast. Organised by POMPKL and Kita Pelari Malaysia with Pure Events, it's a community-driven race with genuine grassroots backing. Two distances (42K, 21K) with registration open. Kuantan is known for its beaches (Teluk Cempedak), its satay, and its laid-back east-coast character. September is the tail of the southwest monsoon — warm but generally drier than the November-March northeast monsoon. A solid east-coast Malaysian marathon with open registration.
